payload.summary: Pre-existing, found while verifying the tray fix: between roughly 860px and 1240px viewport width the table clips horizontally. #row-bets min-content (five bet spots at 152/208/168/208/152 plus gaps = 668px) is wider than the felt content box (500px at vw 1000), and since a grid item cannot be narrower than its min-content the whole single column widens to 668 and #table-view { overflow: hidden } cuts 168px off the right. Measured identically on main with the tray change stashed, so the tray work neither causes nor worsens it. Fix belongs with the bet row: let the spots shrink, wrap, or scroll in that band.
